# conductorone_session_policy (Resource)

SessionPolicy Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "conductorone_session_policy" "my_sessionpolicy" {
  access_token_ttl_seconds = 5
  continuous_default_outcome = {
    allow = {
      floor_level = "AUTH_LEVEL_NONE"
    }
    challenge_required = {
      types = [
        "CREDENTIAL_TYPE_DELEGATED_MICROSOFT"
      ]
    }
    deny = {
      reason_admin = "...my_reason_admin..."
      reason_user  = "...my_reason_user..."
    }
    enrollment_required = {
      credential_types = [
        "CREDENTIAL_TYPE_RECOVERY_CODE"
      ]
    }
    step_up_required = {
      level           = "AUTH_LEVEL_UNSPECIFIED"
      max_age_seconds = 6
      types = [
        "CREDENTIAL_TYPE_PASSWORD"
      ]
    }
  }
  continuous_rules = [
    {
      description = "...my_description..."
      id          = "...my_id..."
      match_cel   = "...my_match_cel..."
      mode        = "POLICY_RULE_MODE_DISABLED"
      outcome = {
        allow = {
          floor_level = "AUTH_LEVEL_UNSPECIFIED"
        }
        challenge_required = {
          types = [
            "CREDENTIAL_TYPE_DELEGATED_GOOGLE"
          ]
        }
        deny = {
          reason_admin = "...my_reason_admin..."
          reason_user  = "...my_reason_user..."
        }
        enrollment_required = {
          credential_types = [
            "CREDENTIAL_TYPE_RECOVERY_CODE"
          ]
        }
        step_up_required = {
          level           = "AUTH_LEVEL_PHRH"
          max_age_seconds = 7
          types = [
            "CREDENTIAL_TYPE_PASSWORD"
          ]
        }
      }
    }
  ]
  credential_durations = [
    {
      access_token_ttl_seconds     = 6
      credential_type              = "CREDENTIAL_TYPE_RECOVERY_CODE"
      max_session_duration_seconds = 3
    }
  ]
  display_name                    = "...my_display_name..."
  idle_timeout_seconds            = 7
  max_session_duration_seconds    = 6
  persistence                     = "PERSISTENCE_MODE_ALLOW_USER_CHOICE"
  priority                        = 3
  refresh_rotation_window_seconds = 3
  refresh_token_ttl_seconds       = 8
  rotate_refresh_on_use           = true
  session_policy_service_delete_request = {
    # ...
  }
  ssf_receive = {
    enabled = true
    ssf_receiver_stream_ids = [
      "..."
    ]
  }
  ssf_transmit = {
    enabled = true
    event_types = [
      "..."
    ]
    ssf_transmitter_stream_ids = [
      "..."
    ]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `display_name` (String) The displayName field.

### Optional

- `access_token_ttl_seconds` (Number) The accessTokenTtlSeconds field.
- `continuous_default_outcome` (Attributes) PolicyOutcome is the effect of a matched rule. Exactly one kind is set. For
 session continuous-evaluation, the meaningful kinds are Allow (continue),
 Deny (terminate), and StepUpRequired.

This message contains a oneof named kind. Only a single field of the following list may be set at a time:
  - allow
  - deny
  - stepUpRequired
  - challengeRequired
  - enrollmentRequired (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--continuous_default_outcome))
- `continuous_rules` (Attributes List) The continuousRules field. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--continuous_rules))
- `credential_durations` (Attributes List) The credentialDurations field. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credential_durations))
- `idle_timeout_seconds` (Number) The idleTimeoutSeconds field.
- `max_session_duration_seconds` (Number) The maxSessionDurationSeconds field.
- `persistence` (String) The persistence field. possible known values include one of ["PERSISTENCE_MODE_UNSPECIFIED", "PERSISTENCE_MODE_ALLOW_USER_CHOICE", "PERSISTENCE_MODE_ALWAYS_PERSIST", "PERSISTENCE_MODE_SESSION_ONLY"]
- `priority` (Number) The priority field.
- `refresh_rotation_window_seconds` (Number) The refreshRotationWindowSeconds field.
- `refresh_token_ttl_seconds` (Number) The refreshTokenTtlSeconds field.
- `rotate_refresh_on_use` (Boolean) The rotateRefreshOnUse field.
- `session_policy_service_delete_request` (Attributes) The SessionPolicyServiceDeleteRequest message. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--session_policy_service_delete_request))
- `ssf_receive` (Attributes) SSFReceiverConfig selects which inbound shared-signals streams this session
 trusts. Each stream's issuer, keys, expected audience, and per-event actions
 are configured on the stream itself; this policy just lists the stream IDs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ssf_receive))
- `ssf_transmit` (Attributes) SSFTransmitterConfig selects which outbound shared-signals streams this
 session emits security events to. Each stream's delivery endpoint,
 authentication, and per-event allowlist are configured on the stream itself;
 this policy just lists the stream IDs and the event types to emit. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ssf_transmit))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the policy.
- `is_builtin` (Boolean) True for built-in policies provided by ConductorOne. Built-in policies
 cannot be edited or deleted.
- `updated_at` (String)

### Nested Schema for `continuous_default_outcome`

Optional:

- `allow` (Attributes) Allow continues the session. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--continuous_default_outcome--allow))
- `challenge_required` (Attributes) ChallengeRequired asks for an additional factor. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--continuous_default_outcome--challenge_required))
- `deny` (Attributes) Deny terminates the session. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--continuous_default_outcome--deny))
- `enrollment_required` (Attributes) EnrollmentRequired tells the user to enroll a credential before continuing. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--continuous_default_outcome--enrollment_required))
- `step_up_required` (Attributes) StepUpRequired demands a stronger re-authentication before the session may
 continue. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--continuous_default_outcome--step_up_required))

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = conductorone_session_policy.my_conductorone_session_policy
  id = "..."
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import conductorone_session_policy.my_conductorone_session_policy "..."
```
